kinds_note: A kind is a presentation hint for interfaces: what the user can do next. It is not HTTP semantics; every code keeps its own HTTP status, and an interface may give a code its own hint instead of its kind's.

kinds.client: The request is wrong for this server: fix it before sending it again.
kinds.conflict: The request is valid but conflicts with the current state: resolve it, then retry.
kinds.unavailable: A dependency is temporarily unavailable: retrying later may succeed.
kinds.remote: The outcome on the other side is unknown: check before retrying.
kinds.internal: The system failed while handling a valid request: see the logs and the recording.

AMBIGUOUS_STREAM.description: The recording has several streams; name the stream_id.

BROWSER_REQUEST_REJECTED.description: A Node refused a request sent by a web browser (the controller answers cross-site writes with BAD_REQUEST).

CALL_ID_CONFLICT.description: The call id is already in use.

CANCELLED.description: The call was cancelled on request.

COMPONENT_BUSY.description: The component is already running a call.

COMPONENT_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: A required component setting or file is missing.

CONTEXT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED.description: The inputs exceed the model's context budget.

CONTROLLER_UNREACHABLE.description: The controller could not be reached.

CYCLIC_PIPELINE.description: The pipeline graph contains a cycle.

DEVICE_BUSY.description: Another component holds the device's resource group.

DUPLICATE_NODE_ID.description: Another live Node registered with the same node_id.

ENCODER_CONTRACT_MISMATCH.description: Media taxonomy: an encoder produced output that breaks its contract.

EXCLUSIVE_GROUP_BUSY.description: A member of the exclusive group is loading, stopping or busy.

EXCLUSIVE_GROUP_CONFLICT.description: An idle member holds the exclusive group; retry with replace_exclusive.

FILE_HASH_MISMATCH.description: A file's SHA-256 differs from its FileRef.

FILE_TRUNCATED.description: A file is shorter than its declared size.

GPU_MEMORY_INSUFFICIENT.description: A memory pre-check found too little free GPU memory for this configuration; nothing was loaded or run.

GPU_OOM.description: The GPU ran out of memory.

HOST_MEMORY_INSUFFICIENT.description: A memory pre-check found too little free host memory for this configuration; nothing was loaded or run.

HOST_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The Host header is not one the server answers: its allowed_hosts, or without that setting IP addresses, localhost and the server's own names.

HOST_OOM.description: The host ran out of memory.

HOST_PROTECTION.description: The Node's host protection (admission in its configuration) held a call back until its deadline or cancelled it while it ran: the chip or GPU was too hot, or free host memory fell below the floor; details.reason and the message give the reading. Retry once the host has cooled down or freed memory.

INPUT_TOO_LARGE.description: An input exceeds a semantic limit (frames, pixels, characters...).

INTEGRITY_MISMATCH.description: Media taxonomy: a file changed or failed an integrity check.

INTERRUPTED.description: The run was interrupted (e.g. the controller restarted); Node-side work may have continued.

INVALID_ARGUMENT.description: A field is missing, malformed or out of range.

LATENT_MISMATCH.description: A latent's layout, shape or space is not what the consumer needs.

LATENT_SOURCE_MISMATCH.description: A latent's linked blob or source differs from its manifest.

LOAD_TIMEOUT.description: Loading the component exceeded its deadline.

MEDIA_INCOMPLETE.description: A media asset is incomplete or failed its frame or sample verification.

METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED.description: The HTTP method is not supported on this path.

MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE.description: The input or the weights do not match what the component expects.

MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID.description: The model produced output that fails validation.

NODE_INTERNAL_ERROR.description: The Node failed unexpectedly while handling the request.

NODE_UNREACHABLE.description: The Node could not be reached.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.description: The request body or upload exceeds the server's transport limit.

PORT_MISMATCH.description: A pipeline wire connects incompatible port types.

PREVIEW_NOT_FOUND.description: No preview is available for that call or step.

PROCESS_EXIT_UNCONFIRMED.description: The component process may still be running; its exit is unconfirmed.

PROMPT_TOO_LONG.description: The prompt exceeds the text encoder's limit.

PROTOCOL_ERROR.description: A component process received a control message it could not parse.

PROTOCOL_MISMATCH.description: The peer speaks an incompatible protocol version.

PROVIDER_NOT_INSTALLED.description: The runtime has no such provider (package missing or not enabled).

RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE.description: The requested byte range is outside the file.

RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED.description: Media taxonomy: the work would exceed a resource limit.

REVISION_CONFLICT.description: The document changed since it was read; reload and save again.

RUBRIC_MISMATCH.description: The evaluation rubric does not match the study.

RUNTIME_ERROR.description: The component or service failed while handling the request.

RUNTIME_EXITED.description: The component process exited during the operation.

RUNTIME_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: The Node has no runtime with this id.

RUNTIME_START_FAILED.description: The component process could not be started.

RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE.description: The runtime environment cannot run this provider right now.

SETTINGS_NOT_LOADED.description: The saved settings differ from the loaded ones; restart to apply.

STATE_CONFLICT.description: The resource's current state does not allow this operation.

STUDIO_PLUGIN_INSTALL_DISABLED.description: The Controller's configuration file turns plugin installation and removal through the API off.

STUDIO_PLUGIN_INVALID.description: The plugin package breaks a package rule (archive, paths, sizes, manifest or integrity); details.errors lists up to 20 problems.

STUDIO_TIMELINE_REJECTED.description: A timeline command or export was refused and nothing was saved; details.reason is the stable reason.

TASK_RUNNING.description: A study task is still marked running; stop it or mark it interrupted first.

TRACE_UNAVAILABLE.description: The recording has no profiler trace.

UNSUPPORTED_COMBINATION.description: Media taxonomy: the requested media combination is not supported.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.description: The body's Content-Type is not the one the endpoint needs (application/json for JSON endpoints, application/octet-stream for a plugin package).

UNSUPPORTED_SETTING.description: The component does not support this setting or combination.

UPSTREAM_PATCH_SOURCE_MISMATCH.description: A pinned upstream function changed; the runtime refuses to patch it.

WEIGHTS_DESTINATION_CONFLICT.description: The destination holds files that differ from the pinned weights; they are replaced only when asked.

WEIGHTS_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE.description: The weight source (Hugging Face or HF_ENDPOINT) could not be reached or refused the download.

notices.CANCEL_NO_ANSWER: A cancel request got no answer from the Node in time.
notices.DETAIL_TRUNCATED: Some detail events were not recorded (a bounded queue or limit was reached).
notices.TRACE_TRUNCATED: The profiler trace exceeded its size limit and was not kept.
notices.TRACE_UNAVAILABLE: The profiler trace could not be started or exported.
